decisions.reason: The existing message-204 MODIFY already records the proportional Hero V derivation, locked second-V geometry and hierarchy, and proportional application of the selected terminal treatment.
The existing message-204 MODIFY already records the Hero V as the locked master geometry with its agreed right-arm elevation preserved during terminal exploration.
The existing message-204 MODIFY already preserves exact Hero V and É accent peak alignment unless the client requests a change.

The existing message-204 MODIFY fully captures the reopened six-option terminal exploration and the rule to apply the selected Hero V treatment directly to the É accent and proportionally to the second V.
The existing message-204 MODIFY already preserves the agreed second-V elevation and quiet subordinate relationship; no additional hierarchy update or removal is required.
The source keeps all non-terminal geometry identical and shifts exploration to the Hero V terminal; it does not change the architectural E and L requirements.
The source message separately introduces the two-column review protocol, and that independent requirement already has a complete message-204 INTRODUCE event.
The terminal exploration concerns geometric and material-quality language at the terminal but does not change the selected champagne-gold finish or distribution state.
The client directs that everything outside terminal treatment remain identical, so the selected Balanced Flow kerning remains valid unchanged.
The message preserves the established alphabet cap-height relationship and does not alter the rule aligning E and L height to the second V's left arm.
The new visual review format does not remove or modify the existing obligation to explain design intentions and their translation into letterforms.
The source does not discuss or alter the established common baseline; directing all other geometry to remain identical leaves this requirement unchanged.
